name: handshake
description: Context-continuity plugin that maintains durable checkpoints and resumes through the next prompt or explicit /handshake resume. Does not rely on SessionStart rehydration.

monitors.name: handshake-checkpointer
monitors.description: Maintains fresh Handshake checkpoints by distilling transcript + git state. Runs in compact mode.

monitors.name: handshake-context-monitor
monitors.description: Warns when Claude Code context pressure crosses checkpoint thresholds (70/80/90/95%). Polls context.json written by the statusline sensor.
